fee_notes: The Initial Fees consist of two components: (1) a fixed Initial Franchise Fee of $14,900, and (2) a Territory Fee of $1.10 per Target Household, which typically ranges from $33,000–$49,500 (mid-size market) to $49,500–$77,000 (standard-size market). In the year ended December 31, 2025, actual Initial Fees paid ranged from $38,091 to $84,379 (average ~$68,244). The Initial Franchise Fee is waived for qualifying existing franchisees adding contiguous territory or simultaneously buying an existing unit. Discounts available include: VetFran (20% off Territory Fee), Roll-In Discount (5%–50% off Territory Fee based on rolled-in gross sales), Multi-Unit Franchisee Discount (5%–20% off Territory Fee based on years as franchisee), and Additional Concept Discount (10% off Initial Franchise Fee). A Software System enrollment fee of $1,250 per license is also due at signing.
raw_excerpt: An initial franchise fee of $14,900 (the "Initial Franchise Fee"); and A territory fee equal to $1.10 per Target Household ("TH") in your Territory... Territory Fees typically range from $49,500 to $77,000 for a standard-size market and $33,000 to $49,500 for a mid-size market... In the year ended December 31, 2025, the average Initial Fees paid by Molly Maid franchisees was approximately $68,244 and the Initial Fees paid during that period ranged from $38,091 to $84,379 based on the population in the territory purchased and available discounts.
